name: galhardo-video
description: Monorepo: backend FastAPI, frontend Next.js e bot do Telegram. Os scripts rodam os 3 workspaces.

scripts.setup: bun install && cd frontend && bun install
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:telegram && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.format: sh infra/scripts/python.sh backend -m ruff format . && sh infra/scripts/python.sh telegram -m ruff format . && cd frontend && bun run check
scripts.format:check: sh infra/scripts/python.sh backend -m ruff format --check . && sh infra/scripts/python.sh telegram -m ruff format --check . && cd frontend && bun run format:check
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:telegram && bun run test:frontend
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:telegram && bun run build:frontend
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
